inspector_audit.interpretation: Fused metadata links are not a per-operation internal compute trace. Listed external tensor formats are direct inspector evidence. Four fused geometry layers include 16 GridSample operations with Half inputs/grids/outputs.

output_quantization_only.description: Only round stored FP32 outputs to FP16 then back to FP32; no model or TensorRT execution. Independent mask recomputation, unchanged thresholds.

original_amp_gate_report.interpretation: Fixed numerical gates compare two uncalibrated candidates, not geometry accuracy or safety. Residuals use nominal sparse LiDAR references and retain large differences. Offline timings exclude ROS, simulator contention and planning.

tests.scope: Generic suite regression, not a numerical acceptance proof. Policy APIs and constraints exercised by actual pinned SDK build and all 12 image pairs.

preflight_failures: First: ILayer lacks compute_precision; fixed explicit derived layer class.
Second: IActivationLayer exposes activation kind as type, not activation_type; fixed against installed SDK.
